1.objective: Clear the full five-band sand slope with the bus routes still open.
1.keyChallenge: The first board teaches how quickly five parking spaces can fill.
1.quickAnswer: Match the cyan, white, yellow, orange, and dark-red bands with the same-color buses shown in the video. Send one useful bus at a time, let it collect sand, and keep at least one parking space open before starting the next color.
overallStrategy: Level 1 is a queue-control lesson. The sand is arranged in broad vertical bands, but the buses below face several directions, so an available color is not always an available route.
Use the road as a checkpoint. When a bus leaves the holding area, confirm that its color is being removed before adding another vehicle.
